case_name: State of Madhya Pradesh and Others v Sardar and another
petitioner: State of Madhya Pradesh and Others
respondent:
Sardar and another
Supreme Court of India

25 July 2001
Appeal (Cr.) 871 of 1997
The Judgment was delivered by: S. N. Variava, J.
1. These two appeals by special leave are directed against orders dated 28th June, 1996 and 17th July, 1996 passed by the High Court of Madhya Pradesh at Jabalpur in Criminal Appeal No. 490 of 1990.
2. Briefly stated the facts are as follows:

facts: It is the case of the prosecution that on 20th February, 1987 PW1 Yaqub was coming back from the forest near his village Khokariya, under the jurisdiction of Police Station Narwar district Ujjain, and on the way he was accosted by accused No. 4 Sardar.
It is the case of the prosecution that Sardar caught hold of Yaqub, by his collar, slapped him, abused him and threatened him for lodging many reports against him;
The door of Mubarik's house was closed.
Thereafter, accused broke open the door with the axe, entered the house and assaulted Mubarik Yusuf PW4 and Ahmad Noor (Since deceased);
FIR for the offences under Sections 307/452/147/148/149/294/506/323/329/294, IPC was lodged.
Ahmad Noor then expired in his hospital.
issues: Whether the prosecution has proved its case beyond reasonable doubt against all accused?
petitioner_arguments: There is no evidence of any independent witnesses, even though there would be many such witnesses as the incident had taken place during day time in a village.
The prosecution witnesses are all interested persons belonging to the complainant group.
They were all biased witnesses who falsely deposed in order to falsely implicate the accused.
These witnesses had contradicted themselves in material particulars.
The investigation has been one sided and that the accused have lodged FIR prior in time for the serious injuries caused to them
The prosecution has not explained serious injuries to 3 of the accused persons.
respondent_arguments: In an incident like this, where two group in a village fight, no independent person comes forth to give evidence or even make a statement.
The evidence where it has been deposed to by the police witnesses that nobody was willing to make any statement.
Sardar was the main accused who had accosted, threatened and beaten Yakub, who had then beaten Ismile and who had then gone, along with other accused armed with axe at Mubarik's house.
The evidence clearly implicates Sardar and brings out the major role that he has played.
court_reasoning: Looking to the fact that door was broke open and 3 persons of complainant party have sustained injuries out of them Ahmad Noor died arid therefore, the number of persons who entered the house and caused injuries must have been more.

As the door was broke open possibility of presence of axe in the hand of some of the accused is also probable, but looking to the fact as two persons have been extended benefit which has finalised because of non filing of appeal by the State, the person placed in the similar situation is entitled to the same benefit.
Sardar also deserves same benefit as his participation becomes doubtful and does not stand corroborated from the medical evidence.
holding: The Appeal filed by the State against acquittal of Sardar be dismissed
The Appeal filed by the accused requires to be allowed and all be acquitted
